# Third-party decoders (public domain)

The decoders behind `PcmSource` on the desktop are unmodified copies of these libraries, pinned by commit.

| Library | Source | Commit | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| minimp3 (`minimp3.h`, `minimp3_ex.h`) | github.com/lieff/minimp3 | `ea99364f61c14656440e8d77e9c233ccf3124633` | CC0 / public domain (`minimp3/LICENSE`) |
| stb_vorbis (`stb_vorbis.c`) | github.com/nothings/stb | `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20` | public domain or MIT, your choice (see the end of the file) |
